e.title: MMNPP Reserving (UNSW)
e.summary: 马尔可夫调制非齐次泊松过程（MMNPP）计数推断与准备金论文代码（Avanzi/Taylor/Wong/Xian）
e.body: reserving-MMNPP 是论文《Inference of counts using Markov-modulated non-homogeneous Poisson processes》的代码（Avanzi, Taylor, Wong, Xian）：用马尔可夫调制非齐次泊松过程（MMNPP）做理赔计数推断与准备金——把索赔到达过程的随机强度建模（状态切换）用于 IBNR 准备金。UNSW agi-lab 团队，准备金方法的随机过程前沿。关联 [[reserving-ensemble]]、[[reserving-robust]]、[[chainladder]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：Avanzi/Taylor/Wong/Xian，MMNPP 计数推断与准备金 R 代码，UNSW Actuarial Software Directory 收录
e.summary_en: Paper code for count inference and reserving with Markov-modulated non-homogeneous Poisson processes (Avanzi/Taylor/Wong/Xian)
e.summary_hk: 馬爾可夫調製非齊次泊松過程（MMNPP）計數推斷與準備金論文代碼（Avanzi/Taylor/Wong/Xian）
e.body_en: reserving-MMNPP is the code of the paper 'Inference of counts using Markov-modulated non-homogeneous Poisson processes' (Avanzi, Taylor, Wong, Xian): count inference and reserving with MMNPP — modelling stochastic intensity (state switching) of the claims-arrival process for IBNR reserving. UNSW agi-lab team; the stochastic-process frontier of reserving methods. Related: [[reserving-ensemble]], [[reserving-robust]], [[chainladder]], [[actuarial-pricing]].
e.body_hk: reserving-MMNPP 是論文《Inference of counts using Markov-modulated non-homogeneous Poisson processes》的代碼（Avanzi, Taylor, Wong, Xian）：用馬爾可夫調製非齊次泊松過程（MMNPP）做理賠計數推斷與準備金——把索賠到達過程的隨機強度建模（狀態切換）用於 IBNR 準備金。UNSW agi-lab 團隊，準備金方法的隨機過程前沿。關聯 [[reserving-ensemble]]、[[reserving-robust]]、[[chainladder]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。
